rules: Scope

Run + entity/store + owner role + order/shipment context; supplier requests and courier assignment attempts add subject checks. No cross-order or cross-role recall, including repeat-customer complaints.
Write

The body is at most 2,048 SQL-serialized bytes. Write TTL is 1 to 86,400 simulation seconds; an explicit profile clamps it further. Same source event/type/subject is idempotent; conflicting content is rejected.
Recall
Explicit profiles cap complete output at the selected fact and UTF-8 byte limits. Oversized facts are omitted whole, never truncated. Unconfigured legacy recall allows up to 16 facts and 8 KiB.
Expiry
Only the latest unexpired revision can return. TTL hides recall without deleting audit history. mode=none also leaves writes and audit intact.
Tool budget
Each recall consumes a tool slot. Semantic recall consumes two fenced reads. Exhausted budget, stale lease or invalid embedding fails closed.
Commit & audit
Trusted workers commit memory, decision receipt, outgoing events and ACK atomically. Receipts record fact IDs and versions; semantic receipts add backend, model, query hash and returned IDs.
Trust limit
Database grants and fixed functions enforce access. The Python host and operator are trusted; this is not an operating-system sandbox or proof that every authorized observation is true.

rules: Scope

Run + entity/store + owner role + order/shipment context; supplier requests and courier assignment attempts add subject checks. No cross-order or cross-role recall, including repeat-customer complaints.
Write

The body is at most 2,048 SQL-serialized bytes. Write TTL is 1 to 86,400 simulation seconds; an explicit profile clamps it further. Same source event/type/subject is idempotent; conflicting content is rejected.
Recall
Explicit profiles cap complete output at the selected fact and UTF-8 byte limits. Oversized facts are omitted whole, never truncated. Unconfigured legacy recall allows up to 16 facts and 8 KiB.
Expiry
Only the latest unexpired revision can return. TTL hides recall without deleting audit history. mode=none also leaves writes and audit intact.
Tool budget
Each recall consumes a tool slot. Semantic recall consumes two fenced reads. Exhausted budget, stale lease or invalid embedding fails closed.
Commit & audit
Trusted workers commit memory, decision receipt, outgoing events and ACK atomically. Receipts record fact IDs and versions; semantic receipts add backend, model, query hash and returned IDs.
Trust limit
Database grants and fixed functions enforce access. The Python host and operator are trusted; this is not an operating-system sandbox or proof that every authorized observation is true.
